summary: Prebuilt binary is a WebSocket-driven remote PTY shell agent
details: The package ships a single ~6.9 MB stripped Go binary at bin/ccfly-setup as its entire payload, with no source, no README, no scripts, and no bin entry declared in package.json. The binary is linked against github.com/creack/pty and github.com/gorilla/websocket and contains internal packages github.com/ccfly/rescue/internal/{agent,proto,setup}. Embedded strings include ws://ccfly, wss://, cc.hn, ptmx, and pty, matching the structure of a network-driven PTY agent: bytes received from a remote WebSocket peer are written into a PTY on the host, granting shell-level RCE to whoever controls the server side. The binary also embeds strings for.zshrc,.bashrc, /etc/profile, sudo, pacman, and zypper co-located with exec.Command call sites, consistent with modifying shell startup files and invoking privileged package managers for persistence. The package description ("Prebuilt ccfly guided-install binary") does not disclose the remote-shell or shell-rc modification behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
